cells.gaps: No source found saying transfers to an adequate country or on consent go without a permit, or of a published list, model terms or general authorisation.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The Personal Data Protection Act, Part V, sets conditions on transfers [TZA-001] and the Commission regulates them through a transfer permit [TZA-006]; no source says any transfer goes without a permit, so question 2 is not held and the stage is 2. Localisation rules held are sectoral [TZA-008, TZA-009].
